# OpenTemplates - Tailwind CSS & React Components and Templates

> Production-ready, framework-agnostic Tailwind CSS and React component slices, landing pages, and templates. Built with Fumadocs documentation. Free and open source under the MIT License.

## Overview
OpenTemplates provides a curated library of modular React + Tailwind CSS components and complete full-page templates. Every component is self-contained, customizable, accessible, and structured for copy-paste use or direct ingestion by autonomous AI coding agents (such as Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf).

- Framework: React 19 / Next.js 15 (App Router compatible)
- Documentation: Fumadocs (fumadocs-ui & fumadocs-core)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS (v3/v4 utility classes)
- Accessible Primitives: Headless UI, Heroicons, Lucide React
- License: MIT (Free for commercial and personal use)

## Documentation & Routes
- Documentation Home: `/docs`
- AI Agent Standard: `/docs/agent-standard`
- Machine-Readable Index: `/llms.txt`
- Component Pages: `/docs/components/[slug]`
- Template Pages: `/docs/templates/[slug]`

## Full-Page Production Templates

1. AI Global Summit & Tech Conference
   - Live Route: `/templates/conference`
   - Documentation: `/docs/templates/conference`
   - File: `src/app/templates/conference/page.tsx`
   - Features: Hero registration, multi-day agenda schedule tabs, speaker gallery, sponsor cloud, newsletter capture.

2. Developer & Creator Dark Mode Portfolio
   - Live Route: `/templates/portfolio`
   - Documentation: `/docs/templates/portfolio`
   - File: `src/app/templates/portfolio/page.tsx`
   - Features: Persistent theme switcher (Dark/Light), publications, speaking gigs, career timeline, project showcase.

3. Modern Ecommerce Storefront
   - Live Route: `/templates/ecommerce`
   - Documentation: `/docs/templates/ecommerce`
   - File: `src/app/templates/ecommerce/page.tsx`
   - Features: Store navigation with mega menu, hero promotional banners, technical specs grid, category catalogue.

4. Faceted Product Collection Catalog
   - Live Route: `/templates/collection`
   - Documentation: `/docs/templates/collection`
   - File: `src/app/templates/collection/page.tsx`
   - Features: Slide-over responsive filter drawer, sorting controls, product list grids, thumbnail queues.

5. SaaS Product Launch Starter
   - Live Route: `/templates/starter`
   - Documentation: `/docs/templates/starter`
   - File: `src/app/templates/starter/page.tsx`
   - Features: Complete conversion funnel combining hero, features, comparative pricing, team, blog, and contact form.

## AI Agent Instructions
To use any component with an autonomous agent:
1. Reference the component file path or documentation URL directly from this document.
2. Ensure Tailwind CSS is configured in your project with `@headlessui/react` and `@heroicons/react`.
3. Copy the component into your project's component directory or import it directly.
